build_provenance: The immutable binary was built from frozen dirty HEAD 14fad818 before the later acceptance commit; all 601 exact recorded inputs were subsequently mapped to the engine source commit. The packaging commit changes documentation only.

privacy: Private task/handoff documents, full development history, private reports, validation runtime, profiles and credentials are excluded from this payload.
